role: Target custodian and code reviewer; not fully outcome-blind independent auditor
scope: Pure controller/evaluator/dependency-code review and invented tests. No true reference, participant design/observed table, or new source candidate contents opened.
verdict: No unresolved actionable release-gate issue found in the reviewed version. Authorized custodian preparation is distinct from evaluator release.

resolved_findings.resolution: required_paths enforces exact mandatory path coverage. prepared_inputs checks observed/design/reference/mapping hashes against preparation_receipt and validates the task-safe manifest hash.

prepared_inputs requires each family bundle observed hash to equal the canonical observed hash. verify_release validates all generated IDs and preserved covariates against canonical observed before returning to the reference-reading caller.

evaluate now records calibrated-minus-initial age and BMI slope deltas and preservation flags at the prespecified 1e-10 tolerance; unestimable comparisons remain None and failures do not trigger tuning.

positive_checks: evaluate calls verify_release before reference CSV parsing.
Required binding hashes and original selected-artifact hashes are verified before evaluation.
Schedule coverage and uniqueness are checked for family/arm/seed; paths are derived from scheduled bundle/run identities.
Release validates output and receipt paths, success, candidate, seed and candidate-freeze hash.
Harness verify_execution verifies staged inputs/output bytes and observed-value preservation.
Reference, design and generated tables have exact unique-ID/order checks at evaluation.
Controller uses exclusive launch/release creation and refuses an existing results directory.

invented_tests.pytest_command: python -m pytest work/m11/evaluator/test_analysis.py work/m11/evaluator/test_gate.py -q --tb=short --basetemp <new directory beneath custodian/reviews>

prior_attempt.cause: Pytest default Windows temp directory access denied before four invented tests started. Rerun with a verified-new workspace temp directory passed all tests.

limitations: No live campaign stage, target reference evaluation or generation command was executed by this review.
Source scientific calibration and candidate contents were outside this code review.
No claim of OS confidentiality or resistance to coordinated rewriting of all manifests; this is the documented procedural shared-filesystem boundary.
Custodian earlier saw public CDC codebook frequency/range sections; no such contents are included in this review.
